item.title: Raj: ACME Solar Commissions 155 MW/470.25 MWh BESS, Total Hits 952 MWh
item.description: Gurugram-based ACME Solar Holdings Ltd, through its various subsidiaries, has commissioned an additional 155 MW / 470.25 MWh of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity. The integrated renewable energy player has now commissioned a total BESS capacity of 297.67 MW / 951.74 MWh. This is part of a total planned BESS capacity of 835 MW / 3,114.64 MWh across these Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs). item.title: Coal India Approves ₹3,160 Cr Guarantee For 875 MW Solar JV Project
item.description: Coal India Limited (CIL) has approved the issuance of a guarantee to CIL Rajasthan Akshay Urja Limited (CRAUL), a subsidiary of the company. In a regulatory filing, Coal India said it approved the latest round of investment at its board meeting to provide a 100% corporate guarantee for debt of up to ₹3,160 crore. item.title: Powerica Limited Raises Rs. 329 Cr From Anchors Ahead Of Rs. 1,100 Cr IPO
item.description: Mumbai-Based Powerica Limited, an integrated power solutions provider, garnered ₹329.40 crore from anchor investors ahead of its initial public offering, which is now open for public subscription. The bourses allocated 83,39,239 equity shares at ₹395 per share to anchor investors, the diesel generator sets (DG sets) provider for both primary and standby applications informed. item.title: Uttar Pradesh Clears 20 MW Floating Solar Plant Project at Gorakhpur’s Chilua Tal
item.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has approved the installation of a 20 MW floating solar power plant at Chilua Tal in Gorakhpur, marking a step forward in expanding renewable energy capacity in the state. The decision was taken during a cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Monday. item.title: KPI Green Energises 376 MWp RE Capacity, IPP Portfolio Reaches 965 MWp
item.description: KPI Green Energy Limited (KPI) has energised an additional 376 MWp (comprising ~182 MWp solar capacity in GUVNL 250/350 MWp project, ~164 MWp Solar capacity, and ~30 MWp Wind capacity in GUVNL 370 MW/677 MWp project). item.title: Suzlon Secures 100 MW Wind Order From GAIL, Marks Sixth Project Partnership
item.description: Enhancing its strategic focus in the PSU segment, Pune-based Suzlon Group entered its sixth wind energy project of 100 MW from Gas Authority of India Limited (GAIL). In a press release, Suzlon Group explained that this is Suzlon’s fourth PSU order of FY26, reflecting its growing strength in the ecosystem owing to its end-to-end capabilities. item.title: Vietnam Plans Two Renewable Energy Hubs by 2030 Under Revised JETP Roadmap
item.description: Vietnam has outlined plans to establish two renewable energy industry and service hubs by 2030 as part of its updated strategy under the Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP). Under the revised plan, renewable energy is expected to account for approximately 47 percent of Vietnam’s total installed power capacity by 2030.
